notes.title: IXION Anniversary - Italian Update & Exclusive Anniversary Giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/1be1f527f9ef82774d37045ce8324adbe0ae9413.png[/img]

Administrators!

Today is a momentous day, as we have reached one year of interstellar exploration and to celebrate, DOLOS A.E.C. invites you to celebrate the first anniversary of IXION.

First and foremost, we’re delighted to share the exciting news that the IXION universe just got a little more diverse and now offers Italian localisation. We’re so grateful to all our Italian administrators who assisted us in this mission and we can’t wait to hear what you think.

But that's not all, Administrators! 

DOLOS AEC has provided us with trading cards of their fearless leaders that you can collect them in game. Earn the cards and trade them for game badges!
There’s also an IXION profile bundle now available in the Steam Points Shop! Personalise your profile with interstellar artwork!  :rocket:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/e5e190d58103dd70c9bf0299ddc9014e1ba7cf10.png[/img]

And the anniversary celebration doesn’t end there! To express our gratitude to our amazing administrators who have created an incredible community around the game and worked hard to save humanity, we are hosting a special giveaway. Five lucky players will have the chance to win an exclusive Anniversary Administrator Pack which includes an IXION T-Shirt, pin badge, art book and a prestigious DOLOS Administrator training award.

To enter the giveaway, we thought we would mark IXION‘s first anniversary by reflecting on your achievements so far. We want to see your TIQQUN screenshots showing your IXION journey via this [url=https://forms.gle/n243ckqosi5jB1Kf8]Google Form[/url].

Just fill in the form above, submit your screenshot and you’ll be in with a chance of winning one of our exclusive Anniversary Administrator packs. The winner will be announced on our socials and you’ll be notified via email on 14th December 2023.

Best of luck administrators, and thank you for a fantastic year of IXION!

notes.title: August 2023 Update is Live
notes.notes:
Thank you, Administrators, for your valued feedback and support since the release.

As previously announced on DOLOS Day, the August update is now live, so get ready to return to the Tiqqun!

Amongst bug fixes and quality of life improvements, we have now added accessibility options to the game, alongside a range of chapter 5 improvements.

[b]IXION Patch Notes 1.0.5.8[/b]
The team has been working hard to bring you an updated chapter 5, new accessibility options, as well as some bug fixes.

Along with this update, we have released four new epic music tracks by Guillaume David. Those who have purchased the OST will get the additional tracks automatically added to their soundtrack. They have also been released on streaming services as IXION - Unearthed Tracks.

Read below to find out more.

[b]Settings and Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to let the game run in the background.
[*] Added Colorblind options.
[*] Added an option to enlarge text size in events and dialogues.
[*] Added an option to change text font.
[*] Added an option to disable screenshake.
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
Added an option to destroy resources in stockpiles.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The achievement ‘Drill Dozer’ is now fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Edden wouldn’t warn about a drone swarm attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where popup windows would appear off-screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where asteroids weren’t being detected.
[*] Fixed an issue where the ship management window could scroll off-screen.
[*] Fixed exploit wherein player could skip the final steps of ‘The Last Stand’ and ‘The Promised Land’.
[/list]

[i][b]Warning, the following patch notes contain spoilers for Chapter 5.[/b][/i]

[b]Chapter 5[/b]
[list]
[*] [spoiler] The Piranesi will now fire missiles during ‘The Last Stand’. [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] A timer is now displayed during ‘The Last Stand’. [/spoiler] 
[*] [spoiler] The Piranesi can now appear earlier in chapter 5, depending on progress. [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] An objective has been added to move the Tiqqun to Remus. [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] Added new dialogue for Agora and Edden. [/spoiler]
[/list]

All existing saves should work with the new update.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.7
notes.notes:
Attention Administrators,

The moment you have been waiting for has arrived – the Difficulty Options update is here!

[previewyoutube=wKgY4o_aVJg;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside general bug fixes, this update brings you four difficulty options to choose from, meaning you can now customize your IXION experience.

Read on for full patch notes.

Thank you again, Administrators, for your valued feedback and support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/e236c818b97e350eaf899590a5a9314fd040fb04.png[/img]

Any new playthrough will now begin with a choice of three difficulty modes:

[b]Journey:[/b] This mode is for players who want to enjoy the game’s narrative and is recommended for those unfamiliar with the city-builder genre.

[b]Default:[/b] This is the intended IXION experience and is recommended for players familiar with city builders.

[b]Challenge:[/b] An unrelenting fight for survival; this mode is for Administrators who really want to test their skills.

Want a bit more customization so you can play IXION how you envisioned? Then this fourth option is for you. In Custom mode, you can adjust a wide variety of game mechanics to your taste. Tired of the constant hull degradation. Turn it off.  Not getting enough workers from cryopods? Change the ratio. Accidents happening too often? Decrease the frequency.

You can also adjust these difficulty parameters via the pause menu mid-playthrough – including in your existing saves! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/e49db54c8044327f7035750b5f798d5099df93a9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn’t build in the top-left tile of Sector 2.
[*] Story-related technologies can now be unlocked when you have 0 Science.
[*] Fixed an issue for some players where ‘restart chapter’ would take them to the previous chapter rather than the current.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/94bd2a5631fc4395d8cc83b23e37d2c03a979655.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed issues that arose from exiting the “Walking into the Lion’s Den” event.
[*] The player can no longer soft-lock their game by ignoring events in chapter 3.
[*] Fixed an issue where repeatedly clicking the credits button increased its scroll speed.
[*] Fixed an issue where crew would disappear if a save game was loaded mid-population transfer.
[*] Food is no longer produced if all food production buildings are turned off.
[*] Arrowheads no longer disappear in the resource transfer window.
[/list]

notes.title: Sci-fi city builder Ixion gets a much-needed difficulty update
notes.notes: I was impressed by the atmosphere and detail of last year's sci-fi city building sim Ixion, but it was undoubtedly a game with a few scorch marks seared across its hull. One of the bigger issues was its unpredictable level of challenge, something Alexander Chatziioannou noted in his review: "The way Ixion stealthily slides into doom-spirals of unsustainability makes reloading preferable to redesigning.".. Read more.

notes.title: IXION: Difficulty Options Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Attention Administrators, 

We’re excited to announce that a new update, which will bring a range of difficulty presets and advanced difficulty customisation options to IXION, will be dropping next month.

Following the announcement in January of our proposed update plan, and due to your valued feedback in our Discord and Steam forums, we decided to bring forward the Difficulty Options update in the schedule to allow more players to enjoy IXION sooner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/b84f1f8be12ebe4ccdefde219141372a609b6f22.png[/img]

Since release in December, a lot of players have expressed a desire for a less punishing experience that would give them a better chance of seeing the game’s gripping narrative through to its epic conclusion. With that in mind, the update will include an ‘Easy’ difficulty mode that will present a more manageable challenge, ensuring the Tiqqun’s hull, and its crew’s trust in you, are easier to maintain. 

For those hard-bitten Administrators seeking an even greater challenge than the original, intended gameplay experience (which will now be classified as ‘Normal’ mode), there’ll be a ‘Hard’ difficulty setting available, too. If you finished the game soon after launch, this is a great excuse to return to the Administrator’s chair and experience all our post-release updates while putting your station-management skills to the test. 

Each of the three aforementioned modes have been carefully tuned to ensure a balanced experience that never feels either trivial nor unachievable. You will, however, have the opportunity to tweak and tune the game’s individual difficulty parameters yourself in the fourth and final game mode, ‘Custom’; here you will find a dizzying array of parameters to adjust, allowing you to put on your game designer hat* and set your own level of challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/04fcd50b4a70047e2768c2ac5750642ec8b36169.png[/img]

In terms of what this schedule change means for our other planned updates, such as Accessibility and Visual Tech Support, we’ll provide an update on in due course. 

*Update does not come with hat

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.6
notes.notes:
Attention Administrators,

The first update of 2023 is live and consists of general bug fixes, UI changes and starvation mechanic changes.

We will continue to look at all feedback and bug reports on Steam and our Discord as our focus is on items raised by our players

The patch notes for [b] Build 1.0.3.6 [/b] are below.

Also this week, we are hosting an AMA on Reddit where Bulwark Studios will answer your IXION questions. The AMA will take place on Thursday 23rd February at 7 pm UTC, on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/]R/Gaming subreddit[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/c82c57d30ace76c822e943fa1281b5ff7cd48107.png[/img]

We have updated the way the starvation mechanic works in IXION.

The crew will continue to eat at set intervals, with meal cycles occurring every 5 cycles. If they are not provided with food at this time they will begin to starve. After missing three meals, the starving population will progressively die.

A crew member will now recover from starvation after eating a single meal. (Previously for starvation to resolve, a crew member would need to consume as many meals as they had missed).

Additionally, rather than waiting for up to 5 cycles till the next meal cycle, starving crew members have the option to eat at the start of the next cycle in which enough food is available. This behavior can be toggled on or off for a Sector from within the Mess Hall's building panel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/e0e79efbaa9ead86780bb3114b80aacd65143910.png[/img]

Technologies related to the critical path of the game will now only require time to research, with no associated science point cost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/7b9a6fc4b709eb4043c4fb2834406ce44de31599.png[/img]

Resource Transfer: implemented a simplified version of the resource transfer UI (the previous settings will still be available as a toggle option)

Cryonics Center: Simplified the building’s UI and removed the Sector limit to better convey that the Cryonics Center’s options only determine the destination of awakened crew, and not the type of crew to be woken

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/762d468c6e9b05029f4f21a143c28279e332cfaf.png[/img]

Fixed an issue where some planets had a graphical issue
Fixed solar panel construction placeholders displaying extremely brightly

[*] Fixed an issue where opening events in Chapter 4 resulted in a dimmed screen and no way to resolve the event
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/e49db54c8044327f7035750b5f798d5099df93a9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the 'Delivery!' ‘Drill Dozer’ & 'What they hide from us' achievements not triggering correctly

notes.title: Update On The Next Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Administrators,

The next IXION update is coming soon - we are looking to release[b] before the end of February. [/b]

Alongside a large number of bug fixes, we wanted to detail a little more about what’s coming in this next update:

[b]Starvation changes [/b]- We have tweaked how starvation resolves. Understandably there was some frustration (e.g. around EKP travel initiation) with having to wait 5 cycles till the next meal cycle for starvation to resolve when enough food was on hand. 

We are still testing the changes to ensure they feel right, but now, if a crew member enters starvation, they will be able to access food supplies via the Mess Hall between meal cycles. (There will be a small UI update on the Mess Hall to convey this to the player). 

[b]Cryonics Center UI [/b]- We have simplified the building UI and removed the Sector limit to better convey that the Cryonics Center’s options only determine the destination of awakened crew, and not the type of crew to be woken. 

[b]Resource transfer [/b]- We have created a simplified version of the resource transfer UI (the existing settings will still be available as a toggle option). This should provide a more intuitive experience to the player when moving resources between Sectors. 

Also in the update will be [b]DLSS support[/b] as well as [b]a change to the Chapter 1 and 2 story technologies - these will now only cost time, rather than Science points to prevent gameplay locks. 
[/b]
(The update will apply to both new and existing saves)

There are a large number of fixes to the issues that have been reported, we are grateful for your continued feedback and bug reports as they have helped us improve the game and, ultimately, your experience playing IXION.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.2 - Bug Fixes and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hello Administrators!

Patch - 1.0.2.2 is live! 

Both the Bulwark and Kasedo teams will soon be winding down for Christmas and as such, this will be the last patch of the year. 

We have been processing all the appreciated feedback we have received so far. This has informed some of our next steps for 2023 - here’s a look ahead to the start of the new year and the areas we will be focusing on:

Continued Balancing - We feel passionately about continuing to refine and update IXION’s balancing to bring you the best experience possible. 

UI improvements - There are some areas of the UI we would like to review and improve, to ensure player understanding and enjoyment. 

Accessibility Options - We would like to add further accessibility options to support IXION’s players. 

Difficulty Options - The big one. IXION is intended to be a challenging game. We are looking at implementing a range of options and/or sliders to influence the game’s systems and difficulty. It is too early to detail how this will look, but we will provide optional presets alongside this - to identify the intended experience, to provide an option for a (very) hard mode, and to allow the player to focus on, and enjoy, the game’s story. 

We are a small team, but a passionate one. The reception to the game has been overwhelming in the best way possible. Please allow us the time to continue to respond to, and address, the items being raised by our wonderful community. 

We look forward to the new year, and the future of IXION.

The stability debuff from stored cryonic pods has been updated - you will now get -1 in a Sector that is storing more cryonic pods than the total active population of the Sector, rather than the previous station-wide debuff of -1 per group of 250 stored cryonic pods.

notes.title: Announcement: Release Date Change
notes.notes:
To our Administrators,

As we enter the final stages before launch and with the teams at Bulwark and Kasedo working tirelessly to ensure a smooth and successful release, we have made the difficult decision to move the release date of IXION to December 7th, 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/cd029a432fd9017320d777e14632a02c23aa8cbc.gif[/img]

This has been a tough call, but deep down we know this is the correct one to make to ensure you, our players, have the most incredible experience aboard the Tiqqun from day one.  

Whilst we are thrilled to have a loyal community so excited to play IXION, we wanted to give our small team of talented and dedicated developers just a little longer to deliver a game that lives up to the praise already received from the community and media alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723327/eaa4c0d83984089734d76cafcac1f30b4e4a4f04.gif[/img]

Thank you for your understanding and continued support and as always, we will continue to provide updates between now and release.

Kasedo Games & Bulwark Studios
